They also planned to enjoy vegan street tacos afterwards. During the conversation, Noor mentioned discussing the AI project with Samantha and Mei at Caroline's Café. Leo met Mei at the museum and they agreed to meet there the next day at 2 PM, making it a triple date with Mei.

Later, Leo talked to Caroline at home around 2026-01-12 13:00, and she expressed interest in discussing the AI music project over coffee. They agreed to meet the following day at 3 PM.

data.content: Talked to Andy at market around 2026-01-12 17:00

Andy: Looking forward to it! Let's also plan our regular park meetings with Diego and Noor, as discussed. How about we meet at the park bench by the fountain next Wednesday at 2 PM?

Leo: Agreed! I'll see you then. Let's make it a regular thing. Here's to creating amazing music together!

Leo: "Sounds delicious! I'll bring my violin and we can work out some tunes together."
